kn5000-5ck: 2026-10-31 (wave 4, lane kn5000-b, sub-lane midi), branch open4/kn5000-b-midi. Traced the readers of the three part bytes the proprietary CCs store. CC 0x91 (part+0x17) is the part's own velocity-switch configuration, twin of the global 0x04134B (F0 50 91, Voice_SetVelSwitchConfig): read only by Voice_Env_ApplyVelocity_Type0/_Type2, it gates the install of the patch's +0x2A octave-shift nibble; sent by SwbtB2_Code9A_Listener for parts 0-2. CC 0x9B (part+0x25) patches bits 11:9 / 14:12 of the voice gate word in Voice_Apply_GateRouting (nibble 0 = force 7, 1 = leave, 2 = force 1; reset 1). CC 0x9D (part+0x26) overrides the low 7 bits of TG register 0x180 (pan): 1 = 0x00, 2 = 0x7F, else the voice's own value (reset 0). No main-CPU sender of 0x9B / 0x9D was found in v10 (search method in the notes). Renamed Voice_CC_91/9B/9D and their setters (Voice_CC_VelSwitchConfig / GateRoutingMode / TgPanMode), fixed the headers and Voice_ResetAllControllers' reset list. Website page draft: notes/open4-kn5000-b/midi/README.md section 'kn5000-5ck', draft for midi-subsystem.md (proprietary-controller table and the stale Research Needed line). Outcome: repo-side work CLOSED; leave open until the docs lane publishes the draft.

Caveats: the 3-byte block-length unit is not checked; most panel-record fields behind the addresses are named only by tag/byte/mask (ram_panel_records.s lacks their keys). kn5000-8dy: 2026-10-31 (wave 4, lane kn5000-b, sub-lane midi), branch open4/kn5000-b-midi. Descriptor +0x30 is a GS drum-set map (drum-set program -> KN5000 kit 0xF0+k: Standard, Room, Power, Electric, Jazz, Brush, Orchestral, Sound Effect Kit), used for bank 0x78 program changes and for part 15; +0x34 is a per-GM-voice note shift (0/+12/-12) that the SMF loader (MidiNoteOn_NonDrumLookupA/B) adds to note numbers on channels other than 10. The voice index of +0x18/+0x1C/+0x30/+0x34 is the GM program number. The C0 sender is SndPart_SendProgramChange (renamed from SendChannelPressure_Prologue): {5, C0, part, program, bank, effect} after SndParam_ApplyMaskClamp, whose program/bank rewrite (0x70 drawbars, 0x40/0x41 kits, RAM user banks) is now documented. Evidence: probes/sound_desc_slots_30_34.py, scripts/generators/gen_sound_patch_catalogue.py; comments in audio/sound_data.s of all five maincpu trees. Website page draft: notes/open4-kn5000-b/midi/README.md section 'kn5000-8dy' (sound-categories.md slot rows and step 4). Outcome: CLOSED repo-side; leave open until published.
